name: BOTS v1 - Web Defacement + Cerber Ransomware
description: Techniques observed during the Splunk Boss of the SOC v1 investigation. Orange = Scenario 1 (web defacement of imreallynotbatman.com). Red = Scenario 2 (Cerber ransomware on we8105desk / we9041srv). Purple = seen in both.

techniques.comment: S1: Attacker infrastructure hosted on Azure (40.80.148.42) and AWS (23.22.63.114)
S1: Acunetix vulnerability scan from 40.80.148.42 against imreallynotbatman.com
S1: 412 Python-urllib login attempts against Joomla admin; password 'batman' found
S1: Attacker logged in as Joomla admin with brute-forced password
S1: agent.php web shell uploaded and used by 23.22.63.114
S1: Meterpreter C2 on 23.22.63.114:3791; defacement image served on port 1337
S1: Site defaced with poisonivy-is-coming-for-you-batman.jpeg
S1: php-cgi.exe -> cmd.exe -> 3791.exe | S2: WINWORD.EXE -> cmd.exe writes and launches VBS
S1: 3791.exe uploaded to web server, defacement image downloaded | S2: mhtr.jpg payload downloaded from solidaritedeproximite.org
S2: Malicious document opened from D:\ (removable media). Closest available match.
S2: bob.smith opened Miranda_Tate_unveiled.dotm
S2: VBA macro and obfuscated 20429.vbs downloader
S2: wmic shadowcopy delete
S2: Encoded strings, mixed case and junk arithmetic in VBS
S2: Sleep loops delayed payload download by ~5 minutes
S2: XOR-decoded mhtr.jpg into 121214.tmp
S2: Ransomware copied to AppData\Roaming\{GUID}\osk.exe
S2: Executable payload disguised as mhtr.jpg
S2: Likely - osk.exe launched explorer.exe (injection not directly observed)
S2: 121214.tmp and osk.exe self-deleted via taskkill + del
S2: Cerber UDP check-in to 85.93.0.0/16
S2: External IP lookup via ipinfo.io/json
S2: vssadmin delete shadows; bcdedit recoveryenabled no
